title: Narrative tenses mastery
note: Nuanced narrative: past simple/cont/perfect/perfect cont combinations · scene vs flashback vs background · thin shell 2026-08-06

cards.title: Narrative control, not new tenses
cards.body: You already know the past forms. At C1 choose **which combination** builds the story: main events, background, earlier past, interrupted process, and why one form is sharper than another.
cards.body_cz: Minulé tvary znáte. Na C1 volíte **která kombinace** staví příběh: hlavní děj, pozadí, dřívější minulost, přerušený proces.

items.en: She had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally arrived.
items.cz: Čekala už hodinu, když autobus konečně přijel.
items.gap: She ____ waiting for an hour when the bus finally arrived.
accepts: She had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally arrived.
items.explanation: Past perfect continuous: process before a past event.
items.explanation_cz: Předminulý průběhový: proces před minulým dějem.

items.en: The streets were empty; it had stopped raining.
items.gap: The streets were empty; it ____ raining.
accepts: The streets were empty; it had stopped raining.
items.explanation: Result already true in the past scene: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Výsledek už platil v minulé scéně: past perfect.

items.en: While he was speaking, someone knocked.
accepts: While he was speaking, someone knocked.

items.en: I realised I had left my keys at home.
items.cz: Uvědomil jsem si, že jsem doma nechal klíče.
items.gap: I realised I ____ my keys at home.
accepts: I realised I had left my keys at home.

items.en: By the time we sat down, the film had already started.
items.cz: Než jsme si sedli, film už začal.
items.gap: By the time we sat down, the film ____ already started.
accepts: By the time we sat down, the film had already started.
items.explanation: by the time + past perfect for the earlier event.

items.en: She used to visit every summer, but that year she didn't come.
items.cz: Každé léto jezdívala, ale ten rok nepřijela.
items.gap: She ____ visit every summer, but that year she didn't come.
accepts: She used to visit every summer, but that year she didn't come.
items.explanation: Past habit vs single narrative year.

items.en: He had only been working there for a week when he resigned.
items.cz: Pracoval tam teprve týden, když dal výpověď.
items.gap: He had only been ____ there for a week when he resigned.
accepts: He had only been working there for a week when he resigned.
items.explanation: Short prior process before a past decision.

items.en: Everything seemed normal until the lights went out.
items.cz: Všechno vypadalo normálně, dokud nezhasla světla.
items.gap: Everything ____ normal until the lights went out.
accepts: Everything seemed normal until the lights went out.

items.en: They had known each other for years before they got married.
items.cz: Znali se roky, než se vzali.
items.gap: They ____ each other for years before they got married.
accepts: They had known each other for years before they got married.
items.explanation: State lasting up to a past event: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Stav až k minulému bodu: past perfect.

items.en: I was going to apologise, but she had already left.
items.cz: Chtěl jsem se omluvit, ale už odešla.
items.gap: I was going to apologise, but she ____ already left.
accepts: I was going to apologise, but she had already left.
